samples.PMMA: Acryplen (Mitsubishi Rayon), folha fina de 0,125 mm; teste de blowoff com 8 cm × 2 cm × 0,125 mm

model.equation5: Rrad + 1/Da = 1 at the limiting oxygen concentration (extinction when the sum exceeds unity)
model.Da: B1 · (lambda_g/(rho_g c_g)) · rho_g Y_O A exp(-E/(R Tf)) / Vg_eff^2 (Eq. 4, blow-off location xd fixed at 4 cm)
model.Rrad: B2 · eps(1 - aabs) sigma (Tv^4 - Tinf^4) / (rho_g c_g Vg (Tf - Tinf)) (Eq. 5)
model.VgEff: Vg / (Pr Re_x)^(1/2)-type boundary-layer correction, Re_x = Vg xd / nu (Eq. 3)

B2.calibratedFrom: 4.5-s drop tower: radiative extinction at Vg = 3 cm/s and 21 % O2

notesFromText: Text p. 30: 'In the previous experiment (Ref. 17), the minimum oxygen concentration in which the flame survived in microgravity was 14.7 % where the opposed flow velocity was 6 cm/s' (PMMA), while Table 2 prints MLOC experiment 14.9 %.
Text p. 33: NOMEX MLOC by parabolic flights 29.5 %, predicted 29.6 %.
